fields.description: Controls Sales Invoice creation from Lease Contract rent schedule rows. Invoices are not submitted automatically unless explicitly enabled.
fields.label: Invoice Generation

fields.description: Allow users and services to create rent Sales Invoices from Rent Schedule rows.
fields.label: Enable Rent Invoice Generation

fields.description: Submit generated rent Sales Invoices automatically only when this is explicitly enabled and ERPNext accounting validation passes.
fields.label: Auto Submit Rent Invoice

fields.description: Allow one Sales Invoice to include more than one Rent Schedule row from the same Lease Contract.
fields.label: Allow Grouped Rent Invoice

fields.description: Default non-stock item used on rent Sales Invoice rows.
fields.label: Default Rent Item

fields.description: Require Unit accounting dimension on rent Sales Invoice Items for future GL-level rental revenue traceability.
fields.label: Require Unit Dimension

fields.description: Automatically refresh Rent Schedule and Lease Contract collection totals when rent invoices or payment entries are submitted or cancelled.
fields.label: Auto Update Rent Status

fields.description: Grace days after the due date before unpaid rent is treated as overdue.
fields.label: Overdue Grace Days

fields.description: Allow partial rent collections through standard ERPNext Payment Entry references.
fields.label: Allow Partial Collection

fields.description: Prevent creating more than one active Sales Invoice for the same Rent Schedule row.
fields.label: Block Duplicate Invoice for Rent Schedule

fields.description: Require a Customer tenant on Lease Contract before rent invoice generation.
fields.label: Require Customer on Lease

fields.description: Require Unit on every rent Sales Invoice Item linked to a Lease Contract.
fields.label: Require Unit on Invoice Item

fields.description: Use the company default currency for generated rent Sales Invoices.
fields.label: Use Company Default Currency

name: Rent Invoice Collection Settings
description: Controls rent Sales Invoice creation and collection tracking from Lease Contract Rent Schedule rows.
